title: てみる, the や particle, から and the exclusive "and"
summary: Try something and see with 〜てみる, list things with と (complete) versus や (and more), and mark a starting point with から.

blocks.text: In this lesson you will learn how to try something and see what happens (〜てみる), how to talk about time frames with 間, two ways of listing nouns (と and や), and the particle から ("from").

Attach **みる** to a て-form and the verb means "do it to find out what happens". You are confident you can do the action; you are unsure of the result (how it tastes, what it is like). It is a gentle, curious try.
この料理を食べてみる。 食べて is white; みる is the engine.

blocks.jp: この料理を食べてみる。

lines.jp: これ、おいしいよ。食べてみてください。
lines.en: This is delicious. Try it and see.
Okay, I'll give it a go.

blocks.jp: もう一度やってみてください。
blocks.en: Please try doing it once more.

blocks.text: Here is a sentence with 見える ("is visible"). Remember 本が読める from lesson 10: with a word like this, the main carriage is the thing seen, here 何も ("nothing"), not the person looking.

blocks.jp: 下を見てみた。でも、暗すぎて何も見えなかった。
blocks.en: I tried looking down. But it was too dark to see anything.

blocks.text: **すぎる** after a stem means "too much": 暗い → 暗**すぎる** (too dark).
**間** means a stretch of time, "while". A clause + 間に marks the time frame; this is an absolute time frame, so it takes に.

blocks.jp: 落ちる間に、周りを見た。

blocks.text: Words ending in **り** (ゆっくり, たっぷり, ぎっしり) are adverbs and take no に.

blocks.jp: さくらはゆっくり周りを見た。

blocks.text: **その後** ("after that") is a relative time word, so it takes no に either.

blocks.en: After that, Sakura went to sleep.

blocks.text: Both join nouns, but **と** is **exclusive**: the list is complete. **や** is **non-exhaustive**: these things, among others.

blocks.en: There are pens and pencils (and nothing else).
There are pens, pencils and so on.

lines.en: Only a pen and a pencil.

blocks.text: **から** marks the point something starts from: where, or when.

blocks.en: (I) took a jar from the shelf.

blocks.title: Summary
rows: ペンと鉛筆 / ペンや鉛筆

blocks.title: Remember
items: **て-form + みる**: try doing it and see what happens.
**と**: a complete list. **や**: some examples, and others.
**から**: from a place or a time.

questions.note: て-form + みる.

questions.prompt: 先生の話を聞いて＿＿ください。
questions.note: て-form + みて + ください.
questions.en: Please try listening to the teacher's talk.

questions.prompt: かごにりんご＿＿バナナがあります。
questions.note: や lists examples and implies more.
questions.en: There are apples, bananas and so on in the basket.

questions.note: と is exclusive: the list is complete.
questions.en: My family is my father and my mother.

questions.note: から marks the starting point.
questions.en: I walked from the station to school.

questions.note: から ... まで: from ... until.
questions.en: I worked from morning until night.

questions.prompt: 子供が寝ている＿＿、料理を作った。
questions.note: 間に marks the time frame: while.
questions.en: While the child was sleeping, I cooked.

questions.instruction: What is the main carriage here?
options: 何 (the thing that could not be heard)
questions.note: 聞こえる says something is audible, so the heard thing is the main carriage.

questions.prompt: 〜てみる means you are unsure how it will turn out.
questions.note: You can do the action; the result is what you wonder about.

questions.instruction: Which says "I tried a new ramen"?
options: 新しいラーメンを食べてあげた
新しいラーメンを食べてくれた
新しいラーメンを食べてみた
新しいラーメンを食べてもらった
questions.note: て-form + みた: tried and saw.

questions.prompt: I will try on these clothes.
questions.note: て-form + みる.
questions.en: I will try on these clothes.

questions.prompt: I took the key from my bag.
questions.note: から marks where it was taken from.
questions.en: I took the key from my bag.

questions.prompt: I bought a pen and a notebook (nothing else).
questions.note: と joins a complete list.
questions.en: I bought a pen and a notebook (nothing else).

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "and others"
questions.note: や is the non-exhaustive "and".
questions.en: There are pens, notebooks and so on on the desk.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that marks the starting point
questions.note: から: since the morning.
questions.en: It has been raining since morning.

questions.instruction: Tap the word that means "try and see"
questions.note: みる after a て-form: try doing it.

questions.prompt: や means the list is complete and nothing else exists.
questions.note: That is と; や means "among others".
Absolute times take に; relative ones and words ending in り do not.

questions.prompt: 友達を待つ間に、本を読んだ。
questions.note: 間 is a stretch of time.
questions.en: While waiting for my friend, I read a book.

questions.instruction: Which means "I tried reading it, but it was too hard"?
options: 読んでくれて、難しすぎた
読んでみて、難しすぎた
読んであげて、難しすぎた
読んでもらって、難しすぎた
questions.note: て-form + みて: tried it, then the result.

questions.prompt: 昨日、新しい店に行って＿＿。
questions.note: 昨日 needs the past: みた.
questions.en: Yesterday I tried going to a new shop.

questions.instruction: Which says "The wind came in from the window"?
questions.note: から marks where it came from.

questions.prompt: この道は暗＿＿て、歩けない。
questions.note: Stem + すぎ + て: too much.
questions.en: This road is too dark; (I) cannot walk.
